title: Lone Wolf and Cub
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ogami Itto, the shogun's executioner, is framed by the Ura-Yagyu clan leader Yagyu Retsudo, his wife murdered and his house condemned. Refusing seppuku, he takes his infant son Daigoro on the 'road to hell' as assassins for hire, wheeling the boy in a weapon-laden baby cart across Edo-period Japan. Over 28 volumes their revenge against the Yagyu unfolds through episodic contracts and ends in a final duel.
life_message: It holds up unbending fidelity to one's chosen path and the bond of father and son, even on a road of death.
